name: Porcelain Cradle Sanctuary
core_rationale: Innermost vitrified white-clay amphitheater of Continent 01 where Sola's unbroken ceramic boss-medallion radiates warm hearth-light beneath the central lake.
local_conflict: Luminous glaze-sprites and ancient kiln-wardens guard the sealed inner sanctuary where Hearth-Sparks first condense.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Lantern-Keepers say that when the central pond in Lantern Hollow is completely still, you can see the white-gold roofs of Porcelain Cradle reflected below.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A sunken amphitheater of translucent white porcelain domes glowing softly beneath shallow warm springs.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Does Sola's original Hearth-Loom still weave new spirit-lanterns inside the Porcelain Cradle?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin at the innermost core of Continent 01 Hearthbloom Basin.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Translucent white porcelain domes glowing beneath warm spring-water at the center of Sola's shield.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m celadon-glazed causeways, 0.58m porcelain tea-counters, and 0.14m stepping-stones for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: awaiting playable leaf map authoring for Celadon Causeway and Porcelain Sanctuary Town.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook and reserves hunting-area-celadon-causeway as a Mystery frontier.
